verified_assertions: The caller supplies only sessionToken, delegationId, idempotencyKey, correlationId, taskRef, inputRef and inputSha256; Tenant, region, Provider, data class, model and price cannot be injected.
C05 identity resolution, C06 MANAGE authorization, exact decision binding, final C05 re-resolution and C03 ACTIVE admission all precede data policy, storage and Provider use.
The frozen Synthetic input catalog, rather than caller text, determines data classification, LOCAL_ONLY policy and estimated input Tokens.
Data classification, region, LOCAL_ONLY, capability, context and quality filters run before deterministic quality, task-weighted cost and latency comparison.
Fallback is limited to the Route's frozen candidate bindings and LOCAL_ONLY exhaustion never invokes a cloud model.
Catalog, Tenant policy, Task, model content, rates and rejection reasons are versioned and hashed into the immutable Route ledger.
Quota reservation is atomic, uses the maximum exact task-weighted cost across all allowed models and rejects concurrent over-budget admission.
Provider usage is accepted only from a receipt bound to the effect key, Provider, model reference and model version, and cannot exceed reserved Tokens or cost.
Provider effect keys, idempotent Route creation and durable C0 Mock receipts yield one Synthetic effect across retries, concurrency and restart.
The public success DTO exposes only the nineteen OpenAPI fields and omits Tenant, identity, authorization, candidate rejection, internal quota and Provider attempt evidence.
PostgreSQL rows are isolated by signed C07 Tenant scope; runtime roles lack DELETE, SUPERUSER and BYPASSRLS, and terminal Route bindings cannot be changed or deleted.
All Providers are deterministic C0 Synthetic mocks with no network, and no real model endpoint, enterprise connector, company data or credential is present.

limitations: This evidence verifies only P1 Synthetic model-gateway behavior; it does not include real enterprise identity, organization, permissions, data, OA, U9, BI or any Enterprise Connector.
All model Providers are deterministic C0 mocks with no network; no real OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Bedrock or local-model endpoint is tested.
The file-backed receipt Store proves only local C0 Mock replay behavior and is not a production Provider billing ledger.
PostgreSQL testing uses one-use local PostgreSQL 17.10 instances over Unix sockets; production mTLS, pooling, managed-service constraints, multi-node failover and backups are not verified.
No production model quality, latency, throughput, rate limit, cost, local GPU capacity, vLLM deployment, canary outcome, SLO, high availability or disaster recovery claim is made.
C19 remains responsible for unified model, Tool, sandbox and infrastructure usage reconciliation; C14 does not claim that cross-module ledger.
Model catalog lifecycle activation and rollback are later O04 and O06 governance work, not P1 C14 verification.
C14 verification does not approve G1, enter P2 or permit enterprise integration; those state changes require the frozen stage package and explicit external Product Owner decision.
